anchor.snippet: test('game pane releases mouse buttons outside the canvas without releasing held movement', { timeout: 30000 }, async t => {

entries.note: The normal desktop game pane is attached to a real SDL/GL fixture process. Assertions read events received by that native process, not outbound browser packets or fabricated game state. Pointer-down, chorded mouse buttons and release are browser input actions. The forced-loss case invokes the browser's releasePointerCapture API after a movement has established capture: clearing a still-pending capture before any subsequent pointer event does not produce lostpointercapture. RENGINE_REQUIRE_POINTER_LOCK=1 additionally requires native window focus, actual pointer lock and Escape release; it fails on a locked Mac console. A default button-release pass does not cover that extra gate. This fixture tests the pane/native input boundary; separate NOLF gameplay evidence is still required.
